user.title: EcoFlow Stream (Public API)
user.description: Enter the AccessKey and SecretKey from the EcoFlow Developer portal (developer.ecoflow.com).

devices.title: Choose devices
devices.description: Select which discovered devices you want Home Assistant to set up. You can change this later from the integration's Configure screen.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the EcoFlow API.
error.no_devices: No devices were found for this account.

abort.already_configured: This account and group are already configured.

init.title: EcoFlow Stream devices
init.description: Tick the devices you want enabled. Untick a device to stop Home Assistant setting it up (for example, a unit you have removed). Newly added hardware is picked up automatically when this screen re-scans your account.
